description_expanded:
This beautiful South Side home is a welcome addition to the Alys Beach Rental Program. The home features four bedrooms, all with private baths. The first level offers a large courtyard with private pool and covered seating area. Inside, guests will find a bedroom on the first floor with king-sized bed as well as a spacious family room with ample seating, open kitchen with large center island, wet-bar area, laundry room and a half bath. On the second floor, a large media room with plenty of seating opens to a second floor covered patio with outdoor dining table. Also on the second floor, guests will find the primary suite with king-sized bed, a third bedroom with a king-sized bed and a fourth bedroom with two queen-sized beds. Parking for this home is located in two designated spaces in a parking court. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding 97 South Charles Street. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
